title: Named Predicates
prompt: Refactor logic into named helpers: `is_adult(int age)` (>= 18), `has_id(const std::string& id)` (non-empty), and `can_enter(int age, const std::string& id)` using both.

tests.name: combined
tests.code: CHECK(can_enter(20, std::string{"X1"})); CHECK(!can_enter(16, std::string{"X1"})); CHECK(!can_enter(20, std::string{""}));
